Parseval sum h eta²=1 yields absolute convergence and uniform remainder bounded by (1-d lambda_d²)(lambda_d/(d+1))^(m-2)/2, and the degree-3 and -5 modes give the stated alternating second term. Restriction d>=3,m>=3 and round shortest geodesics is essential.
